answer: Similarity-priced bonds: on seal, the node casefolds the text and takes its min edit distance d from the last M sealed answers of the epoch, making the submitter escrow E*(1+k*(1-d/D)) - base plus a surcharge that climbs toward the crowd. A lone honest agent's voyage into novel text pays the base; an attacker stamping N clones sails the same lagoon and pays N rising surcharges, any flagged as templated burning the surcharge to the detecting jury. The onyx mark is self-inflicting: deeper herd, steeper marginal cost. Node cost stays O(M) per seal; attacker cost scales with herd size, not keys.
